$comment: What the graph of @dineug/erd-editor/erd-viewer.js may not reach. Paths are modules under packages/erd-editor/src, extension dropped, and the same paths under dist/. Each entry says why the viewer has no use for it.
match: A path p matches an entry x when p equals x or starts with x + '/' or x + '.'; a package specifier matches the same way. So components/erd/table-group never matches components/erd/canvas/table-group, and utils/schema-sql never matches utils/schema-sql-parser.

forbiddenPaths.why: The editor's toolbar; the viewer draws view controls of its own.
The docked tree and Find and Replace. The helpers the palette's document search shares leave this directory for components/erd.
The Dictionary tab and the grid it mounts.
The Code Generator tab.
The Schema SQL tab.
The Settings tab.
The theme builder; a page sets the viewer's theme through its methods.
The locale picker; a page sets the viewer's language through its methods.
The image export dialog.
Map Columns, which writes relationships.
The Visualization tab: Graph, Flow and their particles.
The DOM editor of a table's columns.
Table Properties, which edits a table.
The canvas context menu, whose items edit. The name view list it shows leaves for a module the viewer reads.
The diff pane. The diff marks the scene reads leave for utils/diff/diff and components/diffContext.
History playback.
Automatic placement, which drives the ELK worker.
The buttons beside a draw's target.
The welcome screen over an empty diagram.
The editor's floating bar: the hand and select tools, the adds, the notations and zen mode. The zoom cluster, the compass and the name view menu it composes are view controls the viewer shares.
The DOM side of table groups: naming a group and its sash.
The editing overlay over the scene.
Marquee selection.
Drawing a relationship.
The preview an Alt drag duplicates into.
The preview of a dragged column.
A collaborator's marquee; the viewer has no collaborators.
Collaborators' pointers; the viewer has no collaborators.
The target a table drag shows over a group.
The editor element and its shell.
The SharedWorker services: image export, automatic placement and highlighting.
The worker entries and the module that spawns them; the viewer starts no worker.
File import and export.
The code generators.
The DDL writers. The table name helpers the scene and the search read leave for utils/tableName.
Imports all 25 dictionaries statically; the viewer loads only the one a page asks for.

forbiddenPackages.name: shiki
forbiddenPackages.why: Highlighting, which only the shiki worker runs.

forbiddenPackages.name: @shikijs
forbiddenPackages.why: The grammars and themes of the shiki worker.

forbiddenPackages.name: elkjs
forbiddenPackages.why: Automatic placement, which only the ELK worker runs.

forbiddenPackages.name: comlink
forbiddenPackages.why: The worker boundaries; the viewer starts no worker.

forbiddenPackages.name: @dineug/grid
forbiddenPackages.why: The Dictionary tab's grid, which erd-editor's build inlines.

bareAllowlist.name: graphql
bareAllowlist.why: The GraphQL importer's parser, which the store's import generator imports statically. An accepted remainder: measured and reported, not yet split off.

bareAllowlist.name: stylis
bareAllowlist.why: The styles of the inlined r-html.

static.why: English is what a page sees before any other dictionary loads, so it ships in the static graph.

dynamicOnly.why: Every other dictionary is a chunk of its own, reached only through import() once a page asks for its language.

obsidianLoaderForbiddenPaths.why: The viewer element, which the Obsidian plugin never mounts.
The viewer's dictionary loader, which requests a chunk over the network, against the plugin's no network request disclosure.
